context: Update only the closeout report after the production successors and sentinel invariant have been reviewed. Include a concise findings/disposition matrix, evidence commands/results, explicit R1-R8 decisions, and the final tracker sequence. Do not rewrite the original phase-1 handoff; link it as immutable prior evidence. The report must never claim a CI root lane, quiet-host DuckLake measurement, or prevention mechanism that was not actually run or built.
description: Refresh the committed credential-egress closeout report after this review and the successor queue is resolved. Correctly distinguish merged, open/conflicting, planned, deferred, accepted, and blocked work; record the permanent sentinel invariant’s actual scope and optional-dependency accounting; and preserve links to the original phase-1 findings and the R2/R6/R7 tracker items. The current report is historical and now overstates closure because #1468/#1480 are not both merged and the newly found gaps remain. This is the corrected successor of credential-egress-closeout-report-refresh-v1; its stored rung was repaired during adversarial plan review.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not call the batch closed merely because tracker items are marked done.
anti_patterns.instead: Report merge state, live behavior evidence, and successor coverage separately.
anti_patterns.why: Open/conflicting PRs and behavior-driven residuals can leave the tree unsafe.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not edit the original phase-1 report to make history appear consistent.
anti_patterns.instead: Add corrected current-state evidence to the closeout refresh.
anti_patterns.why: It is the source artifact for the review and must remain auditable.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not manufacture a tracker item for R4, R2, R6, or R7 when the existing decision is accept/defer/retain.
anti_patterns.instead: Link the existing item/deferral and state the exact unmet or deferred condition.
anti_patterns.why: Those residuals already have an explicit decision or existing item.

preserves.behavior: Exact evidence references and tracker IDs for completed and deferred work.
Explicit accepted/deferred rationale for R2, R4, R6, and R7.
The original phase-1 handoff as an immutable linked artifact.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'from pathlib import Path; t=Path("_project/handoffs/2026-08-01-credential-egress-closeout.md").read_text(); assert all(x in t for x in ("raw_metadata","query credentials","#1480","R4","R7"))'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: the closeout report must state the current metadata/query gaps and unresolved merge state before it can claim closure; current report is stale and lacks those facts.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: the historical report does not contain the current residual/disposition evidence; exits 1 before refresh and 0 after it.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'from pathlib import Path; assert Path("_project/handoffs/2026-07-31-credential-egress-phase1-findings.md").exists(); t=Path("_project/handoffs/2026-08-01-credential-egress-closeout.md").read_text(); assert "accepted" in t.lower() or "deferred" in t.lower()'
verifications.description: Regression guard: the original phase-1 handoff remains present and the closeout report retains explicit residual rationale.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: historical evidence and residual disposition are not lost.
